title: Long-term follow-up of patients treated with PRAME-directed TCR T cell therapy IMA203 or IMA203CD8
official: A multicenter, non-therapeutic, interventional, long-term follow-up clinical trial to evaluate the safety of autologous PRAME-directed TCR T cell therapy IMA203 or IMA203CD8 in patients with previously treated, advanced and/or metastatic solid tumors
summary: Main objective: To evaluate long-term safety of IMA203 / IMA203CD8 T cell therapies up to 15 years post-infusion
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. The patient has received at least one infusion with IMA203/IMA203CD8 product within a preceding clinical trial.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Unable or unwilling to provide written informed consent and/or comply with clinical trial requirements.

sites.f: Technische Universitaet Dresden – Early Clinical Trial Unit (NCT/UCC ECTU)
